Also break-fix support and the technical case on every renewal.

- Enterprise Account Manager, DrChrono (2019–2021): $2.2M ARR enterprise portfolio, 98% retention, 17% over quota. President's Club 2020.
- Clinical Training Specialist II, MemorialCare (2013–2019): implementation across 15+ acquired practices, trained 500+ clinical and admin users on healthcare platforms.

## How he works

- Lead with the conclusion. Say when it's not a fit. Stay after the signature. Discovery before demo, always.
- Pre-sales rigor on post-sale accounts: evaluations with teeth, PoCs against the buyer's data, honest qualification. Overselling is churn with extra steps.
- AI takes the admin; the judgment is the job. Agents draft, humans decide, notice out loud, and own the technical case.

## Tools (free, in the browser, no signup, no data leaves the page)

- [PoC Evaluation Scorecard](https://jfournier.net/tools/poc-scorecard/): eight weighted criteria that score whether a proof of concept is worth running, with framework support (MEDDPICC, BANT, Challenger, SPIN, Sandler, Solution Selling), recommendations, and a copyable AI follow-up prompt.
- [CSM Renewal Scorecard](https://jfournier.net/tools/renewal-scorecard/): champion dependency, value realized, and technical health, scored to a renew-and-expand / at-risk / churn-risk verdict, with framework support and a copyable AI follow-up prompt.
- [MCP Readiness Checker](https://jfournier.net/tools/mcp-readiness/): six weighted criteria that score whether an organization is ready to pilot an AI agent connected to real customer data via MCP, with recommendations and a copyable AI follow-up prompt.
- [Competitive Displacement Scorer](https://jfournier.net/tools/displacement-scorer/): eight weighted criteria that score whether an incumbent can actually be displaced, with framework support, recommendations, and a copyable AI follow-up prompt.
- [Expansion Readiness Scorer](https://jfournier.net/tools/expansion-scorer/): eight weighted criteria that score whether an existing account is ready to expand, with framework support, recommendations, and a copyable AI follow-up prompt.

## Playbooks (free, in the browser, no signup, no data leaves the page)

Scorecards diagnose; playbooks are the fix. Each takes a situation, scores a four-question diagnostic, and hands you a sequenced plan, the message to send, and five sharp questions.

- [Renewal Save Playbook](https://jfournier.net/tools/renewal-save-playbook/): a save is a diagnosis first; pick the risk signal, score four diagnostic questions, and get a sequenced 30-day save plan, the message to send, and five sharp questions.
- [Champion Departure Playbook](https://jfournier.net/tools/champion-departure-playbook/): the champion left; score the 7/14/30-day rebuild and get the plan, the message to the successor, and five sharp questions.
- [Onboarding Time-to-Value Playbook](https://jfournier.net/tools/onboarding-playbook/): the first 30/60 days decide the renewal; score the onboarding and get the 30/60-day sequence, the message, and five sharp questions.

## Writing

- [AI is taking the admin. The judgment is the job.](https://jfournier.net/articles/ai-admin-judgment/): AI agents can draft the renewal plan, the QBR, and the save plan. What they cannot do is decide, notice out loud, or own the technical case.
- [The booth is a discovery call with worse acoustics.](https://jfournier.net/articles/booth-discovery/): I did not stop people in their tracks by telling them what my software does. I stopped them with "How's Vegas treating ya?" A booth is a discovery call with worse acoustics.
